```{r setup}
#| include: false
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(reactable)

qc <- readRDS(params$qc)

#' Format a number with thousands separators, or a dash when it is missing
#'
#' @param x a number (or NULL)
#' @param suffix text appended to the number
#' @param fmt sprintf format of the number
#' @return a string
fmt_num <- function(x, suffix = "", fmt = "%s") {
	if (length(x) == 0 || is.na(x)) return("–")
	paste0(sprintf(fmt, if (fmt == "%s") format(x, big.mark = "'") else x), suffix)
}

#' The statistics of the alignment of a set of reads on the assembly
#'
#' @param reads the samtools stats of the reads, as read by read_samtools_stats()
#' @param total_len the length of the assembly
#' @return a list: num_reads, pct_mapped, mean_depth (NA without reads)
reads_summary <- function(reads, total_len) {
	n <- pluck(reads, "SN", "raw.total.sequences", .default = NA_real_)
	list(
		num_reads = n,
		pct_mapped = 100 * pluck(reads, "SN", "reads.mapped", .default = NA_real_) / n,
		mean_depth = pluck(reads, "SN", "bases.mapped..cigar.", .default = NA_real_) / total_len
	)
}

#' Median depth of the contigs, weighted by their length (the depth of the chromosome on an isolate assembly)
#'
#' @param depth the mean depth of each contig
#' @param len the length of each contig
#' @return the weighted median (NA when all the depths are missing)
weighted_median_depth <- function(depth, len) {
	ok <- !is.na(depth)
	if (!any(ok)) return(NA_real_)
	o <- order(depth[ok])
	d <- depth[ok][o]
	w <- cumsum(len[ok][o])
	d[which(w >= w[length(w)] / 2)[1]]
}

#' The depth histogram of a set of reads
#'
#' @param reads the samtools stats of the reads, as read by read_samtools_stats()
#' @return a ggplot, or a message when there are no reads
depth_histogram <- function(reads) {
	h <- reads$COV_HIST
	if (is.null(h) || nrow(h) == 0) return(cat("No reads"))
	ggplot(h, aes(x = range_max, y = count)) +
		geom_col(fill = "grey20") +
		labs(x = "read depth", y = "bases") +
		theme_minimal()
}

stats <- qc$assembly_stats
long <- reads_summary(qc$long_reads, stats$total_len)
short <- reads_summary(qc$short_reads, stats$total_len)

contigs <- qc$contigs |>
	mutate(
		GC_pct = 100 * GC_count / length,
		long_rel = long_cov / weighted_median_depth(long_cov, length),
		short_rel = short_cov / weighted_median_depth(short_cov, length)
	)
```

# Summary

## Row {height=20%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Assembly"
list(icon = "file-earmark-text", color = "primary", value = paste0(qc$sample_id, " (", qc$assembler_name, ")"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total length"
list(icon = "rulers", color = "primary", value = fmt_num(stats$total_len, " bp"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Contigs"
list(icon = "list-ol", color = "primary", value = fmt_num(stats$num_contig))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "N50"
list(icon = "bar-chart", color = "primary", value = fmt_num(stats$N50, " bp"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "GC"
list(icon = "percent", color = "primary", value = fmt_num(100 * stats$GC_pct, " %", "%.1f"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "CheckM2 completeness / contamination"
list(icon = "check2-circle", color = "secondary", value = paste(
	fmt_num(qc$checkm2$Completeness[1], " %", "%.1f"),
	fmt_num(qc$checkm2$Contamination[1], " %", "%.1f"),
	sep = " / "
))
```

## Row {height=40%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Long reads"
list(icon = "arrow-left-right", color = "info", value = fmt_num(long$num_reads))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Long reads mapped"
list(icon = "bullseye", color = if (is.na(long$pct_mapped)) "light" else if (long$pct_mapped >= 90) "success" else if (long$pct_mapped >= 80) "warning" else "danger",
	value = fmt_num(long$pct_mapped, " %", "%.1f"))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Long reads mean depth"
list(icon = "layers", color = "info", value = fmt_num(long$mean_depth, "x", "%.1f"))
```

```{r}
#| title: "Long reads depth"
depth_histogram(qc$long_reads)
```

## Row {height=40%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox

```

```{r}

#| title: "Short reads mapped"
list(icon = "bullseye", color = if (is.na(short$pct_mapped)) "light" else if (short$pct_mapped >= 90) "success" else if (short$pct_mapped >= 80) "warning" else "danger",
```

# Contigs

## Row {height=55%}

```{r}
#| title: "Contigs (relative depth: depth / length weighted median depth of the contigs)"
contigs |>
	select(contig_id, length, GC_pct, N_count, long_cov, long_rel, short_cov, short_rel) |>
	reactable(
		searchable = TRUE,
		defaultPageSize = 20,
		compact = TRUE,
		striped = TRUE,
		defaultSorted = list(length = "desc"),
		columns = list(
			contig_id = colDef(name = "Contig", minWidth = 200),
			length = colDef(name = "Length", format = colFormat(separators = TRUE)),
			GC_pct = colDef(name = "GC %", format = colFormat(digits = 1)),
			N_count = colDef(name = "N"),
			long_cov = colDef(name = "Long reads depth", format = colFormat(digits = 1)),
			long_rel = colDef(name = "Long reads rel. depth", format = colFormat(digits = 2)),
			short_cov = colDef(name = "Short reads depth", format = colFormat(digits = 1)),
			short_rel = colDef(name = "Short reads rel. depth", format = colFormat(digits = 2))
		)
	)
```

## Row {height=45%}

```{r}
#| title: "Relative depth of the contigs"
d <- contigs |>
	select(contig_id, length, `long reads` = long_rel, `short reads` = short_rel) |>
	pivot_longer(c(`long reads`, `short reads`), names_to = "reads", values_to = "rel_depth") |>
	filter(!is.na(rel_depth))
if (nrow(d) == 0) {
	cat("No reads")
} else {
	ggplot(d, aes(x = length, y = rel_depth, color = reads)) +
		geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
		geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
		scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
		scale_y_log10() +
		labs(x = "contig length (bp)", y = "relative depth", color = NULL) +
		theme_minimal()
}
```
